title: Server Economy: Points, Orders & Trading
h1: Minecraft Server Economy: Points, Buy Orders and Player Trading Explained
description: How a player-driven Minecraft survival economy works: server points, buy orders that pay out while you're offline, player trades, payments and referral rewards.
intro: Some survival servers run a player-driven economy instead of a shop, so items change hands between players. This guide explains points, buy orders, trades and referral rewards. Gilly SMP is the worked example.

items.q: How does a player-driven economy work on a Minecraft survival server?
items.a: On Gilly SMP the economy is entirely player-driven. Players sell items to each other through the order market or trades, and every price on the server is in points, the server currency.

items.q: How do I earn points on a Minecraft survival server?
items.a: New players start with 0 points. You earn them by selling items to other players through the order market, since points are not handed out by the server.

items.q: How do I pay another player in Minecraft?
items.a: Use /points pay <player> <amount>. Amounts are whole numbers of at least 1, and paying less than 1 is refused.

items.q: How do Minecraft buy orders work on a survival server?
items.a: Open the order market with /order and post a buy order with an item, an amount and a price per item of at least 1 point. The points are reserved, and other players deliver the items and get paid instantly, even while you're offline.

items.q: How many buy orders can I have at once in Minecraft?
items.a: On Gilly SMP you can have 5 active orders, with more allowed by rank: 7 on Bronze, 10 on Gold and 15 on Diamond. Orders expire after 14 days.

items.q: Do Minecraft buy orders need the exact item?
items.a: Yes. Items must match the order exactly, including enchantments, damage, custom names and contents. Items can be delivered from shulker boxes.

items.q: How do I trade items with another player in Minecraft?
items.a: Crouch and right-click the player, or use /trade <player>. You must be within 10 blocks, in the same world and not in creative. Both sides can offer items and points, and both must accept. XP can't be traded.

items.q: How do referral rewards work on a Minecraft server?
items.a: Run /referral to see your personal code and give it to a friend. When they join and type /refer <code>, they get 5 diamonds right away and you get 10 once they've played for 2 hours. You can refer up to 5 players, one per IP address.
